fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Stack Model (Nernst + Butler-Volmer + ohmic + concentration, SOC ODE, H2 parasitic, crossover, thermal ODE)
source: Thaller, L.H. (NASA, 1974) US Patent 3,996,064 Redox Flow Cell; Hagedorn, N.H. (1984) NASA TM-83677 'NASA Redox Storage System Development Project'; Gahn, R.F. et al. (1985) NASA TM-87034; Hruska, L.W. & Savinell, R.F. (1981) J. Electrochem. Soc. 128, 18; Zeng, Y.K. et al. (2015) J. Power Sources 278, 294; Wang, W. et al. (2013) Adv. Funct. Mater. 23, 970 (review)

unit.name: Generic NASA-class 40-cell Fe-Cr (ICFB) stack, 500 cm2 electrode area

N_cells.note: Cells in series in the stack

A_cell.note: Active electrode area per cell (NASA Redox single-cell scale)

E0_Fe.note: Standard potential Fe3+ + e- <-> Fe2+ vs SHE (positive)

E0_Cr.note: Standard potential Cr3+ + e- <-> Cr2+ vs SHE (negative). Cell E0 = 0.77-(-0.41)=1.18 V

c_Fe_total.note: Total Fe ion concentration in posolyte (1.0 M, NASA used ~1 M FeCl2/CrCl3 in HCl)

c_Cr_total.note: Total Cr ion concentration in negolyte (1.0 M)

j0_Fe.note: Exchange current density Fe3+/Fe2+ at T_ref (fast couple, on carbon)

j0_Cr.note: Exchange current density Cr3+/Cr2+ at T_ref (SLUGGISH couple, ~100x slower; needs Pb/Au/Bi catalyst). Hagedorn 1984

E_act_Fe.note: Arrhenius activation energy for Fe kinetics

E_act_Cr.note: Arrhenius activation energy for Cr kinetics (high -> strong T sensitivity; warm electrolyte essential, NASA ran ~65 C)

E_act_R.note: Arrhenius activation energy for ohmic resistance (ionic conduction)

j_L.note: Limiting current density (mass transport) at nominal flow

i_H2_ref.note: Reference parasitic H2-evolution current density on Cr side at T_ref, SOC=1 (HER competes with Cr3+ reduction during charge)

E_act_H2.note: Arrhenius activation energy for hydrogen evolution

k_cross.note: Effective crossover diffusion coefficient of active species through membrane (slow self-discharge, ~%/h). Wang 2013 review reports VRFB/Fe-Cr permeabilities O(1e-11..1e-12 m2/s)

V_tank.note: Electrolyte tank volume per side (20 L; lab/pilot 40-cell stack). Q_cap = nF c V ~ 1.93e6 C (~0.54 kAh) so 50 A moves SOC ~0.09/h

Q_flow.note: Volumetric electrolyte flow rate per side (nominal)

m_thermal.note: Lumped thermal mass (stack + 2 tanks of aqueous electrolyte ~ 1000 kg)

cp_thermal.note: Effective specific heat (aqueous HCl electrolyte ~ 3.5 kJ/kg/K)

T_ref.note: Reference temperature for Arrhenius terms (25 C)

temperature.note: 15-65 C operating window (Cr kinetics fail below ~10 C)
